headline: Democratic Midterm Victory Boosts Turkish Markets, Analyst Says
summary: The Democratic Party's victory in U.S. midterm elections has encouraged buying across global stock markets, according to analyst Zeynel Balcı, potentially bolstering Turkish markets.
why: Shifts in U.S. political power can alter risk sentiment and capital flows toward emerging market equities.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: Global stock market buying sparked by US election outcomes encourages gains in Turkish equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Democratic victories in US midterm elections improved global risk appetite, encouraging buying across international stock markets.
